data.title: Understanding the words with a specific structure

data.text: Upar ke alfaaz mein do cheezein mushtarik hain: har lafz (مُ) se shuru hota hai jis par damma hai aur doosre aakhir se pehle wale harf par kasrah hai. Aise alfaaz 'kaam karne wale' ka mafhoom dete hain.
Yeh bahut aasaan qaaida samajhne se aapko darj zail alfaaz samajhne mein madad milegi:
Is asool ko samajhne se aap Quran ke darj zail alfaaz ko aasaani se samajh sakte hain:
Is sabaq mein diye gaye asoolon ko samjhein aur Quranic fiqron ka tarjuma karein.
Ab yeh bhi yaad rakhein: agar lafz (مُ) se shuru ho jis par damma ho aur doosre aakhir se pehle wale harf par fatah ho (jaise مُسَخَّر، مُحَمَّد) to yeh 'jis par kaam kiya gaya' ka mafhoom deta hai.
Arabic mein do ka mafhoom zahir karne ke liye lafz ke aakhir mein (ان) lagaya jata hai, jaise upar ke misaalon se zahir hai.
Aap darj zail Quranic alfaaz ko akser pichle sabaqon se jaante hain, lekin ab in par (ان) ke saath dekhein:
Ab aap in Quranic alfaaz ko khud samajh sakte hain:

items.hinglish: Ek eemaan wala : Do eemaan wale

data.text: Yeh bhi yaad rakhein ke aise alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ان) kabhi kabhi (ين) mein badal jata hai, lekin mafhoom nahi badalta. Darj zail Quranic alfaaz mein yeh farq dekhein:
Ab upar ke tamam alfaaz ko (ين) ke saath bhi parhein.
